author: Lindsay Ellis
description:
Millions of displaced Palestinians live in legal limbo outside Gaza and the West Bank with almost no access to state-backed care. Last year I had the opportunity to shadow Palestine Children's Relief Fund in Jordan and Egypt, exploring the type of aid their nonprofit provides for children and families in the diaspora. 

Tiltify link: https://tilt.fyi/ClIuhzmuv8 

To contribute to the fundraiser, you can either use YouTube Giving or the Tiltify link -- funds raised will go directly to breathing new life to the Palestine Hospital in Cairo and to families across the West Bank, Gaza and the diaspora.
title: How Is Your Charity Money Actually Spent?
